christmas.note: The tick follows the order-by dates published on the gift guide (design2.js deadlines, approved 24 Nov 2026): framed and canvas 8 Dec (mountedOrderBy, both providers), calendars 10 Dec, clothing and tote bags 12 Dec, posters and street prints 15 Dec (gelatoOrderBy; Gelato's own published DE deadline is 16 Dec Economy). Latest estimated arrival <= 23 Dec, 1 calendar day before Christmas Eve, for Gelato and Posterflow alike. Until 24 Nov Gelato used a stricter latest arrival of 16 Dec, which removed the tick about a week before those published dates (Yusuf, 24 Nov 2026: fix the open gaps). Posterflow has no published 2026 cutoff found. Tick is an estimate, never a guarantee.

holidays.policy: Conservative union of German national and regional public holidays; also skip 24 and 31 Dec operational closures. German-destination estimate, not a claim of German manufacture. Gelato can route through PL/CZ; include their relevant public holidays too.
